holds_note: Validation checks the rules a reply must follow, not how well it reads. An agent listed in holds runs on that model whenever it clears the agent's bar, and the cheapest that cleared stays the rule for every other agent. Set 10/27 after reading every Claude model's commentary and memo side by side, and the board deck joined them 10/28 after all seven models' drafts were read. The cheapest model that passed wrote deck headlines that described each slide without saying what it meant.
